note: The entries of a game's list as a slot reads them, and the writes that change them (spec/translation-file/lists.md § seen). `values` is what the game imposes (replaced whole by the extraction); `seen` what was found in the lines (UGT Manager's optimisation) or while playing (the mod) — never removed by an extraction, merged by union. Every entry is invented. Expected values derived by hand from the rule.

of.out: [string]: values in order, then each seen entry not already there; empty and repeated entries are none

seen.out: [string]: the seen a writer writes — old ones, then the found ones, each once, none that values holds

merged.out: [string]: the union of two files' seen, mine first, none that values holds

cases.why: a slot reads what the game imposes, then what was found in the lines
a list born of the lines has no imposed entry
a file written before `seen` reads exactly as before
an entry is one entry, an empty one is none
the old seen first; a found entry the game already imposes or already seen is not written again
an extraction that now imposes « ladder » drops it from seen; « hook » stays — an extraction never removes what was seen
two machines saw different entries: both are kept
